rules.name: Endpoint AV Remediation Action
rules.title: Endpoint antivirus took action on a threat
rules.description: Endpoint telemetry reports a remediation action.

rules.name: Endpoint Protection Disabled
rules.title: Endpoint protection appears disabled or tampered

rules.name: Endpoint Protection Configuration Change
rules.title: Endpoint protection configuration changed
rules.description: An endpoint protection configuration change was reported.

rules.name: Windows Defender Exclusion Added
rules.title: PowerShell added a Windows Defender exclusion
rules.description: PowerShell changed a Defender exclusion setting.

rules.name: Endpoint Protection Update Error
rules.title: Endpoint protection failed to update security intelligence
rules.description: Defender reported a security intelligence update failure.

text_all: error trying to update security intelligence

rules.name: Endpoint Protection Status Update
rules.title: Endpoint protection status update
rules.description: A status update without a higher severity protection or update signal.

text_none: error trying to update security intelligence

rules.name: Encoded / Obfuscated PowerShell
rules.title: Encoded or obfuscated PowerShell execution
rules.description: PowerShell execution has encoded-command or explicit decode/download evidence.

rules.name: LSASS Memory Dump
rules.title: Potential LSASS credential dumping
rules.description: Specific credential dumping tooling or LSASS access/dump evidence was observed.

rules.name: Ransomware Activity
rules.title: Ransomware-like file activity
rules.description: Explicit ransomware or encrypted-file evidence; event-volume correlation is not available per event.

rules.name: Active Directory Database Access
rules.title: Possible NTDS.dit credential theft
rules.description: NTDS database/tooling indicators; IFM alone is not sufficient evidence.

rules.name: Webshell Upload or Execution
rules.title: Possible webshell activity
rules.description: Explicit webshell indicators or suspicious script creation by a web server process.

rules.name: Removable Media Execution
rules.title: Execution from removable media
rules.description: An endpoint explicitly labels execution from removable media; path alone is not treated as proof.

rules.name: Suspicious Outbound C2
rules.title: Suspicious outbound network connection
rules.description: Ordinary network connections are not suspicious without beacon/C2/JARM/remote-shell indicators.

rules.name: Suspicious DNS Activity
rules.title: Suspicious DNS query or tunneling pattern
rules.description: DNS telemetry contains explicit tunnel, DGA, entropy, or TXT tunneling indicators.

rules.name: Authentication Brute Force
rules.title: Brute-force authentication activity
rules.description: A source explicitly reports brute force; event-sequence correlation is not available here.

rules.name: Failed Authentication
rules.title: Failed authentication attempt
rules.description: An explicit failed authentication event was observed.

rules.name: Lateral Movement
rules.title: Possible lateral movement
rules.description: Explicit lateral-movement event or remote execution indicator.

rules.name: Phishing Delivery
rules.title: Suspicious inbound phishing link
rules.description: Explicit phishing event or spearphishing/link evidence from an email source; generic email events are excluded.
